messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Kamal latwal
kamal latwal... that's a solid name with some weight to it. where you working these days?

Atlassian
  ???

atlassian... building the tools that keep half the world's dev teams sane. jira, confluence, the whole ecosystem. found kamal latwal on linkedin but it says product engineer at mathco, not atlassian. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/k-latwal15
No
nah that's not you either - found an ajay latwal instead. can't seem to pin you down. drop your linkedin url or if you got a resume, that works too. need something to work with here
My linked in is not updated

yo i need at least linkedin or resume to find you roles. can't match you blind. even if your linkedin's outdated, it's better than nothing. or throw me a resume - whatever works. gotta know what you've built to know where you fit
Mathco one is it

ah gotcha, so you're at atlassian now but your linkedin still shows the mathco days. product engineer to atlassian... that's a solid jump from analytics consulting to the big leagues. what made you make that switch from mathco to atlassian?
Core engg

core engineering at atlassian... that's where the real magic happens. building the backbone that powers jira, confluence, all the tools that keep dev teams from losing their minds. solid move from the analytics world to core infra. how long you been working total?
4+ years... you've seen enough to know what good engineering looks like and what absolute chaos feels like. what kind of role you looking for next?
Do you have anything better tha current?

lmaooo "anything better than current"... i like the confidence. core engineering at atlassian is already pretty solid - you're not exactly slumming it. but yeah, there's always better. depends what "better" means to you though.

better money? better tech stack? better work-life balance? less meetings? more ownership? 

what's got you thinking about moving from atlassian anyway?
I am not thinking just trying out tal itsled thats you

ah got it... just kicking the tires, seeing what tal's all about. fair enough. 

well here's the thing - i don't do window shopping. if you're happy at atlassian and just curious, that's cool, but i match people with roles they'll actually take. 

but if you're genuinely open to seeing what's out there... bangalore or you open to remote/other cities?

hey kamal - was just thinking about your move from mathco to atlassian. core engineering there is solid, but curious... what would make a role "better" for you? money, tech, ownership, or something else?
